name: Live2D portraits
author: Yidhar
description: Draws Live2D models into Stellaris' portraits (portrait mods declare them).

name: Stellaris MCP bridge
author: Yidhar
description: Lets AI agents read and play the game over MCP: reads engine state and posts the game's own commands. The MCP server is in mcp-server\.

name: Performance
author: Yidhar
description: Faster fleet updates, fleet manager window and flag checks, optional per-day caches. Multiplayer: every player needs the plugin with the same settings.

name: satfix — 数值溢出修复
author: Aa728848
description: 后期 mod 把数值堆得太高时，护盾、装甲、船体的上限会莫名变成 0 或负数，舰船详情里的「伤害」、舰船设计界面里的「船体值」也会显示成负数或者大得离谱的数。这个插件会把这些坏掉的数值改回正常的上限。

name: Stellaris AI recorder
author: Yidhar
description: Records your own commands and event choices to the plugin's recordings folder, as demonstrations for the stellaris-ai network.
